schema.title: Response Post Visuals Retry Api V1 V3 Generations  Generation Id  Visuals Retry Post

post.description:
Accept-only native retry: durable checkpoint + worker-owned recovery.

Routes by execution.last_error.stage:
- item_generation â checkpoint item_generation (work_kind pre_worker_item_retry)
- planning_teaching â checkpoint planning_teaching (work_kind pre_worker_teaching_retry)
- post-approval stages â queued for worker reclaim
Visual failures must use /visuals/retry.
